payload.core_mechanism_summary: Two-pointer greedy pairing: left pointer scans '(' indices from start, right pointer scans ')' indices from end, pairing when left index < right index to form maximal simple subsequence.
payload.rationale: The code collects '(' and ')' indices, then uses a loop with cnt_a increasing and cnt_b decreasing to greedily select pairs, which is the hallmark of a two-pointer greedy algorithm for bracket problems.
